summary: FD_ED_TC_25_Empathy | Threatening Language | Sentiment Detection | Empathy Response | Live Agent Handoff
title: Empathy | Threatening Language | Sentiment Detection | Empathy Response | Live Agent Handoff
description:
Customer uses threatening or aggressive language during the FD flow. Per call transcript: "Sentiment analysis should be used primarily for live agent handoff, while empathy may be relevant for case creation." System must detect threatening sentiment, respond with empathy, and offer live agent handoff.

Prerequisites:
Sentiment analysis enabled; Live agent handoff available; Customer is mid-flow in FD claim
